camera: Flat front-facing UI; a centred modal popup over a dimmed dungeon screen. The region terrain strip behind is a flat top-down painted map, no 3D preview.

hudLayout.topThird: Full-width header: top-left a chunky tilted leather chapter book with a big gold numeral and the word CHAPTER on its cover; to its right a row of three dark inset counter slots (gold hexagon coin, green star XP, magenta meeple henchmen) each with a number; under them a long four-segment progress bar with an amber fraction at its right end. Below the header a full-width polished dark-wood plank band holding a rolled parchment quest scroll with a red wax seal at centre. Under that a khaki tab bar: a wide left tab with a farmhouse location icon and the dungeon name in large pale capitals, and four smaller square tabs on the right showing dark locked location silhouettes. Below the tabs the top-down region terrain strip (forested hills, a teal river, a small grey castle) with a dark empty card slot at its centre, all dimmed by the modal overlay.
hudLayout.middleThird: A tall stone-grey modal panel, about 72% of screen width, centred, spanning roughly 27%-72% of screen height. Near its top a centred bold white title. Below it a large square item showcase: an olive-khaki raised slab frame with a darker brown front lip, holding an amber/gold bordered inner tile with a pure white field and a big glossy painted bunch of three carrots with leafy green tops, a white star glint on the lit carrot. Under the showcase a single small centred number. Behind the modal, at left edge, the corner of a locked purple henchman card with a padlock and 'x1' badge; at right edge a small carrot resource chip with a count and a teal MAX HIRE button peek out.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Below the modal the screen is an empty dark navy gradient field (the unpainted dungeon level list area, dimmed). At the very bottom a dark-wood plank bar with a steel cog settings button at bottom-right; debug text at bottom-left and bottom-centre.

keyElements: chapter book + three currency counters + progress bar header top
quest scroll on wood plank band below header
LOCAL FARM location tab bar with four locked tabs
large framed item showcase tile with carrot icon on white
teal MAX HIRE button and carrot chip peeking behind modal at right
wood bottom bar with cog settings button bottom-right
uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice panels and buttons: flat saturated faces, lighter rounded bevel rim, darker warmer front lip; the modal is a flat stone-grey panel with a thin purple bottom lip and little bevel, the item tile a raised khaki slab with an amber inner frame. Icons are glossy painted item icons with a thin darker self-coloured rim; UI reads as crisp programmatic engine chrome.
colorPalette: Warm brown wood and khaki chrome across the top, muted olive-teal terrain in the upper middle, a flat cool grey modal in the centre with a bright saturated orange-and-green carrot as the single hot accent, and a large flat cool dark navy void filling the lower half.
mood: Clean, informational and calm — a quick item inspection pause.
composition: Strong central focal hierarchy: the eye drops from the bold title to the big bright carrot tile to the count; the header and tab bar frame the top while the dimmed background recedes.
